Subject: Model shortlist, context tiers & token grid — Zephyr Health onboarding

Hi Linda / Raj,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, the implementation kickoff will hinge on two things we want to lock down before the technical kickoff: 1) a short, prioritized model slate for the first 90 days; and 2) an hourly token/grid profile (peak and sustained) so we can size Dedicated capacity and confirm latency SLOs.

To keep things moving, can you confirm the expected busiest hour QPS (or approximate concurrent users during peak hour) and a ballpark monthly active users estimate? If you prefer, send a sample of typical prompts (PII redacted) and we’ll run a quick tokenization pass.

Action items from our side: Kimberly will propose a 3-tier model shortlist (low/mid/high quality tiers) with recommended context windows; Ben will draft an hourly token grid mapping to capacity tiers. I’ll coordinate a 30-min technical kickoff once we have your numbers.

Attachments: none yet — Kimberly will follow up with the shortlist PDF.

Best,
Grace

Hi Grace — thanks for the recap. Couple quick answers:

- Peak busiest hour: ~1200 requests/hour right now on our pilot traffic, expect up to 3x during steady ramp post-launch (so plan for ~3,600 rph as conservative peak).
- Monthly active callers: roughly 25k MAU for the initial rollout (projected to 60k in 6 months).
- Average prompt length today is short (20-40 tokens) but we have a discovery flow that can hit ~600 tokens when fetching multi-document context.

I attached a one-page prompt sample and our expected SLA constraints. Also looping in procurement for contract timing — procurement@zephyrhealth.com will need a draft SOW before the kickoff.

Attachments: zephyr_prompt_samples_20270419.pdf (pdf)

Let me know what else you need prior to the tech sync.

Thanks,
Linda

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Model shortlist, context tiers & token grid — Zephyr Health onboarding

Hi Linda — quick pass from modeling/ops based on your numbers (thanks for those). I attached a concise shortlist PDF with suggested model tiers; summary below:

- Tier A (latency-first): small, quantized model (gpt-medium-quantized) — 2k token context, best for high-throughput transactional calls (expected avg latency 80–120ms token).
- Tier B (balanced): gpt-large-llama-compat — 8k context, good for most discovery flows and moderate batching (latency 200–350ms token).
- Tier C (context-rich): gpt-xtreme/long-context variant — 64k context for multi-document summarization and the 600-token discovery path (latency higher; route only for non-interactive paths).

Recommendations:
- For initial rollout target Tier B as default (covers 20–40 token prompts and 600-token discovery with acceptable perf).
- Configure automatic routing: requests >1024 tokens get flagged to Tier C; requests <256 tokens go to Tier A when latency budget is tight.

Please review the attached shortlist (model_shortlist_v2.pdf) — I included rough cost multipliers and a recommended canary plan.

Kimberly Park
Staff Product Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: model_shortlist_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model shortlist, context tiers & token grid — Zephyr Health onboarding

Grace / team — I took Linda’s peak and MAU numbers and sketched an hourly token grid (attached) mapping to Dedicated capacity bands. Highlights:

- Conservative peak tokens/hour (assume 3,600 rph * avg 300 tokens/request when discovery path is active) => ~1.08M tokens/hour peak.
- Sustained baseline (pilot mix) => ~240k tokens/hour.
- Suggested Dedicated sizing: start with 2 medium GPU nodes with autoscale to 6 during peak windows, route Tier C to burst capacity only.

I put the detailed per-hour breakdown and cost delta in the sheet (zephyr_token_grid_v1.xlsx). I'll be available to run a short tokenization pass if Zephyr sends a small sample JSON of typical sessions.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: zephyr_token_grid_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
